messages:
sam: Heads-up — PR 7812 is waiting on approvals, cutoff in ~30m. Needs 2x approvers, one must be a design owner due to the runtime config tweak. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7812
amira: pinging QA briefly — any flaky tests on this?
mathias: quick skim — change is in runtime/serve/config.go. Looks small but touches cache warming behavior. I can take one approval but would prefer a design owner sign-off for the behavioral change.
sam: snippet of diff: ```diff
- CacheWarmup = false
+ CacheWarmup = true
```
olivia: can you patch the PR description with why we flip warmup for this release? need an explicit rollback note.
sam: added note and a short rationale: flips warmup to reduce cold-start latency for edge cases; tested on staging with ~5% tail-latency improvement, no regressed e2e failures. Rollback is the previous boolean.
deploy-bot: merge-gate: PR 7812 is currently blocked by required reviewer: design-owner (olivia).
amira: QA ran smoke; all green on staging, no new flakes in the last two runs.
tj: taking a second eye now, will post comments ASAP.
mathias: left one nit about a log message but not blocking. resolving now.
tj: LGTM — looked at perf numbers and test run, +1. :white_check_mark:
olivia: reviewing now, thanks for the summary. small question about metrics tagging — can we add `env=warmup` tag? if yes i'll approve.
sam: yes, will add a short metrics tag in the next push and ping back.
sam: pushed tag change, short commit message `add env=warmup tag to warmup metrics`
olivia: LGTM. :thumbsup: 
sam: great — that gives us 2x approvers. anyone watching merge window, please deploy after the cut.
deploy-bot: merge-gate: PR 7812 no longer blocked — required reviewers satisfied. Scheduled merge window: in 22m.
amira: noted, monitoring smoke after merge.
mathias: thanks everyone — will watch for any post-deploy regressions and be ready to rollback if necessary.
sam: thanks all, cutting the merge in the window. :rocket:
